claim: Google's $15 billion data centre in Visakhapatnam, India faces public interest litigation in Andhra Pradesh High Court filed by Jal Biradari over water-supply strain on a nearby reservoir.
quote_fragment: the project will strain water availability by putting stress on a nearby reservoir

claim: Visakhapatnam, the Indian city hosting the Google-Adani data centre, receives 410 million litres of water daily against a requirement of 480 million litres, with rationing common.
